description_en: Creates a voice cloning job and initializes its basic information
description_zh: 创建人声克隆任务，用于初始化配置人声克隆任务的基础信息
kebab_example: aliyun ice create-customized-voice-job --voice-id xiaozhuan --voice-name '小专' --voice-desc '这是一个个性化声音' --gender female --scenario story --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateCustomizedVoiceJob

parameters.help_en:
The custom voice ID. This is typically an English name or Pinyin.

Must be unique among your other custom voices.

Must be 32 characters or fewer.

Can contain only letters and numbers
parameters.help_zh:
自定义的声音 Id （声音的英文或拼音）

不能和您其他的定制声音 Id 重名
不超过 32 个字符
仅支持字母和数字
parameters.name: voice_id

parameters.help_en:
The voice name, typically in Chinese.

Must be 32 characters or fewer
parameters.help_zh:
声音名字（一般为中文名）
不超过 32 个字符
parameters.name: voice_name

parameters.help_en:
The voice description.

Must be 256 characters or fewer
parameters.help_zh:
声音描述
不超过 256 个字符
parameters.name: voice_desc

parameters.help_en:
The gender. Valid values:

female

male
parameters.help_zh:
性别，取值范围：
female：女性
male：男性
parameters.name: gender

parameters.help_en:
The scenario. Valid values:

story

interaction

navigation
parameters.help_zh:
场景，取值范围：
story：故事
interaction：交互
navigation：导航
parameters.name: scenario
